ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida (Vanilla Tempest) ransomware fan-out via PsExec to ADMIN$ shares
ucs.description: Hunts the hallmark Rhysida deployment chain — a single host pushing a payload to many endpoints via psexec.exe with the actor's characteristic '-accepteula -s -h -c -f -d' switch combo (often invoked from a wrapper psexec.ps1). This is the mass-encryption pivot Microsoft attributes to Vanilla Tempest / Storm-0826 and CISA documented in AA23-319A.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false count min(_time) AS first_seen max(_time) AS last_seen values(Processes.process) AS cmds from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("psexec.exe","psexec64.exe","psexesvc.exe","paexec.exe") OR Processes.parent_process="*psexec*") AND Processes.process="*-accepteula*" AND Processes.process="*\\\\*" by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process _time | rename Processes.* AS * | rex field=process max_match=20 "(?i)\\\\\\\\(?<target>[\w\.\-]+)(\s|$)" | rex field=process "(?i)\s(?<payload>[^\s\\]+\.(?:exe|bin|dll))(?:\s|$)" | search process="*-c*" OR process="*-f*" OR process="*-d*" OR process="*-s*" OR process="*-h*" | stats dc(target) AS target_count values(target) AS targets values(payload) AS payloads values(cmds) AS cmd_samples min(first_seen) AS first_seen max(last_seen) AS last_seen by host user process_name | where target_count >= 3 | sort - target_count
ucs.kql:
// Rhysida PsExec mass deployment — one source host pushing payload to N remote hosts via ADMIN$
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where (FileName in~ ("psexec.exe","psexec64.exe","psexesvc.exe","paexec.exe"))
    or (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe")
        and ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)psexec(\.exe)?\s+\\\\[\w\.\-]+")
| where ProcessCommandLine has "-accepteula"
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\\\\[\w\.\-]+\s"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("-c ","-f ","-d ","-s ","-h ")  // Rhysida combo: copy+force+nowait+SYSTEM+highIL
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend TargetHost = extract(@"(?i)\\\\([\w\.\-]+)\s", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Payload = extract(@"(?i)\s([^\s\\]+\.(?:exe|bin|dll))(?:\s|$)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| where isnotempty(TargetHost)
| summarize TargetHosts = make_set(TargetHost, 50),
            TargetCount = dcount(TargetHost),
            Payloads = make_set(Payload, 20),
            CmdSamples = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
        by DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, InitiatingProcessFileName
| where TargetCount >= 3   // empirical: ≥3 distinct ADMIN$ targets within 7d from one source = fan-out
| order by TargetCount desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Rhysida PsExec mass deployment — SecurityEvent 4688 path on Sentinel
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName has_any ("\\psexec.exe","\\psexec64.exe","\\psexesvc.exe","\\paexec.exe")
    or (ParentProcessName has_any ("\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe","\\cmd.exe")
        and CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)psexec(\.exe)?\s+\\\\[\w\.\-]+")
| where CommandLine has "-accepteula"
| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\\\\[\w\.\-]+\s"
| where CommandLine has_any ("-c ","-f ","-d ","-s ","-h ")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend TargetHost = extract(@"(?i)\\\\([\w\.\-]+)\s", 1, CommandLine)
| extend Payload = extract(@"(?i)\s([^\s\\]+\.(?:exe|bin|dll))(?:\s|$)", 1, CommandLine)
| where isnotempty(TargetHost)
| summarize TargetHosts = make_set(TargetHost, 50),
            TargetCount = dcount(TargetHost),
            Payloads = make_set(Payload, 20),
            CmdSamples = make_set(CommandLine, 5),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
        by Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName
| where TargetCount >= 3
| order by TargetCount desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:4688 OR @EventID:1) @Image:(*\\PsExec.exe OR *\\psexec.exe OR *\\PSEXEC.EXE OR *\\PsExec64.exe OR *\\psexec64.exe OR *\\PsExesvc.exe OR *\\psexesvc.exe OR *\\PAExec.exe OR *\\paexec.exe) @CommandLine:(*-accepteula* AND *\\\\* AND (*"-c "* OR *"-f "* OR *"-d "* OR *"-s "* OR *"-h "*)) -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(psexec(64)?|psexesvc|paexec)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)-accepteula", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)\\\\\\\\[\\w\\.\\-]+\\s", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)\\s(-c|-f|-d|-s|-h)(\\s|$)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| TargetHost := regex("(?i)\\\\\\\\(?<host>[\\w\\.\\-]+)\\s", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| TargetHost!=""
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function=[count_as(field=TargetHost, distinct=true, as=TargetCount), collect([TargetHost, CommandLine], limit=20), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)])
| TargetCount >= 3
| sort(TargetCount, order=desc)

ucs.title: [LLM] Rhysida SILENTKILL pre-encryption EDR/AV service teardown
ucs.description: Catches Rhysida's SILENTKILL-style PowerShell/cmd script that iterates through a hard-coded list of AV/EDR services (Defender, SentinelOne, CrowdStrike, Sophos, Symantec, Cybereason, Elastic) and stops/deletes each one via Stop-Service, taskkill /F, sc stop|delete, or net stop. This pre-encryption defense teardown is publicly attributed to Rhysida/Vanilla Tempest by Sentinel One and Cisco Talos as a precursor to the .rhysida payload drop.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=false count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","taskkill.exe","sc.exe","net.exe") AND (Processes.process="*Stop-Service*" OR Processes.process="*Stop-Process*" OR Processes.process="*taskkill*/F*" OR Processes.process="*taskkill */IM*" OR Processes.process="*sc *stop*" OR Processes.process="*sc *delete*" OR Processes.process="*net *stop*") AND (Processes.process="*Sense*" OR Processes.process="*MsMpEng*" OR Processes.process="*WinDefend*" OR Processes.process="*WdNisSvc*" OR Processes.process="*Sophos*" OR Processes.process="*SAVService*" OR Processes.process="*Symantec*" OR Processes.process="*CSAgent*" OR Processes.process="*CSFalcon*" OR Processes.process="*Sentinel*" OR Processes.process="*Cybereason*" OR Processes.process="*ElasticAgent*" OR Processes.process="*BdServicesHost*") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process _time | rename Processes.* AS * | rex field=process max_match=20 "(?i)\b(?<killed>Sense|MsMpEng|WinDefend|WdNisSvc|Sophos\w*|SAVService|Symantec\w*|CSAgent|CSFalcon\w*|Sentinel\w*|Cybereason\w*|ElasticAgent|BdServicesHost)\b" | stats dc(killed) AS distinct_kills values(killed) AS killed_services values(process) AS cmd_samples min(_time) AS first_seen max(_time) AS last_seen by host user parent_process_name process_name | where distinct_kills >= 2 | sort - last_seen
ucs.kql:
// Rhysida SILENTKILL — chained kill of ≥2 distinct security products from one host
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","taskkill.exe","sc.exe","net.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(Stop-Service|Stop-Process|taskkill\s+/(F|IM)|sc\s+(stop|delete)|net\s+stop)"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    "Sense","MsMpEng","WinDefend","WdNisSvc",
    "Sophos","SAVService","SAVAdminService",
    "Symantec","ccSvcHst",
    "CSAgent","CSFalcon",
    "SentinelAgent","SentinelHelperService","SentinelStaticEngine",
    "Cybereason","cyserver",
    "ElasticAgent",
    "BdServicesHost","vsserv")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Killed = extract_all(@"(?i)\b(Sense|MsMpEng|WinDefend|WdNisSvc|Sophos\w*|SAVService|SAVAdminService|Symantec\w*|ccSvcHst|CSAgent|CSFalcon\w*|Sentinel\w*|Cybereason\w*|cyserver|ElasticAgent|BdServicesHost|vsserv)\b", ProcessCommandLine)
| extend DistinctKilled = array_length(Killed)
| where DistinctKilled >= 2   // SILENTKILL hallmark: enumerated list, not one-off uninstall
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          Killed, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc

| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(Stop-Service|Stop-Process|taskkill\s+/(F|IM)|sc\s+(stop|delete)|net\s+stop)"
| where CommandLine has_any (
    "Sense","MsMpEng","WinDefend","WdNisSvc",
    "Sophos","SAVService","SAVAdminService",
    "Symantec","ccSvcHst",
    "CSAgent","CSFalcon",
    "SentinelAgent","SentinelHelperService","SentinelStaticEngine",
    "Cybereason","cyserver",
    "ElasticAgent",
    "BdServicesHost","vsserv")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend Killed = extract_all(@"(?i)\b(Sense|MsMpEng|WinDefend|WdNisSvc|Sophos\w*|SAVService|SAVAdminService|Symantec\w*|ccSvcHst|CSAgent|CSFalcon\w*|Sentinel\w*|Cybereason\w*|cyserver|ElasticAgent|BdServicesHost|vsserv)\b", CommandLine)
| extend DistinctKilled = array_length(Killed)
| where DistinctKilled >= 2
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine,
          Killed, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Rhysida SILENTKILL Pre-Ransomware AV/EDR Service Teardown
id: 7a4f3c2d-1b9e-4f6a-b5d8-rhysida-silentkill
status: experimental
description: Detects Rhysida (Vanilla Tempest) SILENTKILL-style PowerShell/cmd chain that stops or deletes named AV/EDR services prior to dropping the .rhysida ransomware payload.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-319a
  - https://www.sentinelone.com/labs/rhysida-ransomware/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.t1489
  - attack.t1486
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\taskkill.exe'
      - '\sc.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
  selection_verb:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Stop-Service'
      - 'Stop-Process'
      - 'taskkill /F'
      - 'taskkill /IM'
      - 'sc stop'
      - 'sc delete'
      - 'net stop'
  selection_target:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Sense'
      - 'MsMpEng'
      - 'WinDefend'
      - 'WdNisSvc'
      - 'Sophos'
      - 'SAVService'
      - 'Symantec'
      - 'CSFalcon'
      - 'CSAgent'
      - 'SentinelAgent'
      - 'Cybereason'
      - 'ElasticAgent'
      - 'BdServicesHost'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Authorised endpoint-protection migration runbooks
  - SCCM/Intune uninstall packages for retired AV
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:4688 OR @EventID:1) @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\PWSH.EXE OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE OR *\\taskkill.exe OR *\\TASKKILL.EXE OR *\\sc.exe OR *\\SC.EXE OR *\\net.exe OR *\\NET.EXE) @CommandLine:((*Stop-Service* OR *stop-service* OR *Stop-Process* OR *taskkill* OR *"sc stop"* OR *"sc delete"* OR *"net stop"*) AND (*Sense* OR *MsMpEng* OR *WinDefend* OR *WdNisSvc* OR *Sophos* OR *SAVService* OR *Symantec* OR *CSFalcon* OR *CSAgent* OR *SentinelAgent* OR *Cybereason* OR *ElasticAgent* OR *BdServicesHost*)) -@SubjectUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|taskkill|sc|net)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(Stop-Service|Stop-Process|taskkill\\s+/(F|IM)|sc\\s+(stop|delete)|net\\s+stop)", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)(Sense|MsMpEng|WinDefend|WdNisSvc|Sophos|SAVService|Symantec|ccSvcHst|CSAgent|CSFalcon|SentinelAgent|SentinelHelperService|Cybereason|cyserver|ElasticAgent|BdServicesHost)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| Killed := regex("(?i)\\b(?<svc>Sense|MsMpEng|WinDefend|WdNisSvc|Sophos\\w*|SAVService|Symantec\\w*|CSAgent|CSFalcon\\w*|Sentinel\\w*|Cybereason\\w*|ElasticAgent|BdServicesHost)\\b", field=CommandLine, repeat=true, strict=false)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName], function=[count_as(field=svc, distinct=true, as=DistinctKills), collect([svc, CommandLine], limit=20), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)])

The ≥2-distinct-products gate is what distinguishes SILENT
